Created a playable 3D voxel sandbox in `index.html`. It includes a rolling block terrain, trees, a pond, first-person movement, jumping, mining and placing blocks, a six-slot hotbar, and automatic world saves. Touch controls and a pause menu are included.

**Controls:** WASD + mouse to move and look; Space to jump; left-click to mine; right-click to place; 1–6 to select a block. On mobile, use the joystick and action buttons.

Assumption: this is a peaceful, single-player Minecraft-inspired sandbox rather than a recreation of Minecraft’s original assets or systems. I checked the game in-browser; it rendered without console errors.
